ability.name: Lifekelp Pod
ability.effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **^^Idoneth Deepkin Cavalry^^** unit within this unit’s combat range.

ability.name: Dritchleech
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **^^Wizards^^** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit

ability.name: Armour of the Cythai
ability.effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
